sentences.en: No invading army has ever set foot upon Japanese shores.
sentences.zh: 从未有入侵的军队踏上日本的土地。

sentences.en: Some people think that Earth will be invaded by aliens.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为地球会被外星人入侵。

sentences.en: North Korea decided the time was right to invade.
sentences.zh: 北韩决定时机成熟要入侵朝鲜半岛。

senses.zh: 侵入，侵略,进行侵略,蜂拥而入，挤满,（疾病，声音等）袭来，侵袭vt.涌入,侵袭,侵犯,干扰
